messages:
jon: seeing a sudden spike in TLS handshake failures in us-east around 03:22 UTC. errors: 'tls: write alert: internal error' and occasional 'client auth failed'
priya: KMS audit shows a burst of KMSDecryptDenied for keystore unwraps for principal=svc-worker-us starting ~03:12. any recent RBAC merges?
dan: paste from proxy log (redacted):
```
proxy[edge-22]: 2026-04-02T03:22:14Z error: tls: write alert: internal error client=svc-worker-us
keystore[rotator]: 2026-04-02T03:22:14Z error: unwrap failed key=projects/redwood/keys/serving-main err=403 KMSDecryptDenied principal=svc-worker-us
```
marie: audit-trail shows RBAC change merged at 03:05 UTC that added infra:viewer binding in infra namespace. also a deny rule for keystore:unwrap was deployed 02:58 UTC with higher precedence. looks like evaluation order flip depending on controller reconciliation windows
priya: that would explain alternating 200/403s when requests hit different control-plane replicas. quick fixes: 1) explicit allow rolebinding for svc-worker-us 2) temporary KMS grant for the key 3) re-enable rotator local cache for 60s
jon: applying explicit allow now: 
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: keystore-allow-worker-us
  namespace: keystore
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: worker-us
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: keystore-decrypt-allow
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
EOF
```
oncall: rolebinding applied, also patched rotator ROTATOR_CACHE_TTL=60s in keystore namespace. watching metrics and logs now. ETA 3m :white_check_mark:
sec-bot: alert: keystore-decrypt-failures in us-east exceeded threshold at 2026-04-02T03:24:00Z. incident INC-186700 opened and assigned to eng-security
dan: followups: add a preflight smoke test for RBAC rule changes that performs an unwrap from each region prior to merge; require decision-level audit logs for keystore calls; add a transient dual-key allow during alias rotations
marie: also document a runbook step: if you see TLS write alerts coincident with unwrap denies, check recent RBAC merges and key alias swaps before rolling back TLS hardening flags
priya: created SEC-2026-198 to track tasks: RBAC preflight tests, audit-level work, rotator cache defaults, alias-transition checklist. assigning infra+platform.
jon: handshake failures dropping back to baseline over last 6m. will draft a blameless summary with audit IDs and timeline. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
